description: Seed the hotkeys registry from the vanilla key file (custom_keys.keys.xml and the defaults in data.pack): binding, action, context, source. A repo test the tests gate runs fails on any clash between a mod binding and a vanilla or mod binding in the same context, and on OS combos (Alt+F4, Alt+Tab, Alt+Esc, Win+*). Failing-fixture tests. Needed before any mod hotkey (J15 console, J29 gestures, UI).
title: Hotkeys registry and clash gate
